review: Mira — I lead music for a hundred and forty people in Spanish with two guitars and no budget, and every worship site I have ever used gives me English songs and expects me to translate them badly on a Thursday. This is not that. "Mi Corazón Despierta" is written in Spanish, not translated into it, and there is a difference you can hear in the second bar. Twenty different Latin traditions on this platform and somebody actually knew that Puerto Rico and Colombia and Mexico are not one sound. I have to say the other thing too. I cannot afford the subscription. I have done the math twice and it does not work this month and it did not work last month.
